summary: "Rabinal-Achi" by abbé Brasseur de Bourbourg is a Maya theatrical work published in 1866. This rare surviving pre-colonial performance piece tells the story of a devastating conflict between two Maya cities through song, dance, and masked drama. When a prince destroys four cities and attempts to kidnap children, he faces trial and execution.
